description: This PHP source file generates a web page displaying the status and configuration details of network connections, including IPv6 addresses, Wi-Fi, MoCA, WAN, and other network parameters. It includes external PHP files, retrieves network info via functions, and outputs HTML and JavaScript for the web interface.

methods.name: php_KeyExtGet
methods.description: A function that conditionally modifies parameters based on session mode and root string, otherwise calls KeyExtGet.
